relevance_note: The supplementary material reports one patient with a TNFAIP3 variant, "TNFAIP3 (NM_001270508.1): c.1939A>C; p.(Thr647Pro)", diagnosed with "Autoinflammatory syndrome, familial, Behcet-like" (Additional file 1: Table S6), so the paper describes an individual with a TNFAIP3 variant.
method_note: Read only the paper, the schema and the rules. The paper is a 1000-patient rare-disease cohort from a UAE genomics centre; TNFAIP3 appears only twice: (1) Additional file 1: Table S5, which counts 1 patient with 'Autoinflammatory syndrome, familial, Behcet-like', and (2) one row of Additional file 1: Table S6 (sequencing variants in patients with positive findings). Table S6 has no patient-identifier column, so the label follows label rule 3: 'Table S6 row 42', counting data rows from the top of the excerpted table (first data row is the SCN4A row); the excerpt of Table S6 is contiguous from its header rows and contains no '[...]' inside it. 'Het.' was read as the stated zygosity 'heterozygous'. No variant class (missense etc.) and no pathogenicity wording are printed for this variant, so variant_type_as_stated and pathogenicity_as_stated_by_authors are 'not reported'; the ACMG codes PS3, PP3, PP4 are recorded as printed. The row's 'Mode of Inheritance' value 'AD' and its 'Variant Origin' value 'NA' do not state this person's variant origin, so inheritance is 'not reported' (nothing about parental testing). No functional assay result is printed for this variant (PS3 is only a code), so functional_evidence_statement is 'not reported'. is_proband was set true from the group statement 'Of the 1000 probands'. cites_prior_report_of_same_patients is false: the paper never states that any of its patients were described earlier (ref [9] is cited in Methods for variant filtration, not for re-reported patients). No clinical detail is printed for this person, so phenotypic_features is empty (the syndrome name is recorded in disease_label_as_stated only) and every checklist item is 'not reported'. clinical_diagnosis_basis was filled as 'genetic testing' from the row's 'Indication based Exome' plus the syndrome column, since the variant appears in the table of patients with positive findings. Uncertainties: the data-row index 42 depends on the excerpt beginning at the first data row of Table S6; whether is_proband should follow the cohort-wide word 'probands'; whether the syndrome name should also be a phenotypic_features row; whether 'positive findings'/PS3 count as a pathogenicity statement; the table is printed as 'Table S6' (supplementary), not 'Table 6'.
